aboutHtml:
We've been serving Pahiatua since 2008 with a focus on what we do best: stocking and supporting quality outdoor power equipment. We carry STIHL, Masport, Honda Power Equipment, Cub Cadet, Rover, Walker and Hustler, and we're here to help you find the right gear for the job.

Whether you need new equipment, parts, servicing or just solid advice, we've got you covered. Our Click & Collect service means your online orders are ready before you walk in the door. We take pride in the kind of small-town service that builds real connections with the community we're part of.

Pop in and see us. We're here Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings from 9am to 12pm.
